review_evidence: README describes neural-network programming and formal reasoning in one Lean project, with tensor shapes in types and shared definitions used by training, graph transformations, certificate checkers, and proofs.
The hydrated source contains 1248 Lean files and 2618 proposition declarations, far beyond ordinary runtime/backend scaffolding.
Its mathematical meaning, assumptions, graph transformations, verification paths, and proof corpus are substantive formalization prior art.
summary: Retain TorchLean as a large formal neural-network library with executable tensors, proof interfaces, certificate checkers, and mathematical semantics.
